newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD to sign 14 mln real iron ore deal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD to sign 14 mln real iron ore deal.

text.p: Brazilian state miner Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) said it will sign Tuesday a 14 million reais iron ore deal with China's Minimetals trading company.

Under the agreement, CVRD, which sells around 6.0 million tonnes of iron ore and pellets to Chinese steelmakers annually, will sell an additional 600,000 tonnes to China, the company said in a statement.
Further details would be given at 1500 local/1800 GMT Tuesday in Sao Paulo when the presidents of the two companies will be signing the deal.
CVRD is due to be privatized, but the sell-off, which experts say will be the biggest in Latin America so far, has been delayed because of a host of legal challenges.
